| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Claude name | `/fc:setup-knowledge` |
| Codex name | `$fc-setup-knowledge` |

| Description | Optionally declare an external documentation source, confirm it with you, and prove it answers |
| Arguments | `[server name]` |

## Usage

Optional. Run it to declare one external documentation source that the agents reading knowledge can consult. The repo's own `ai-factory/docs/`, ADRs and code stay the knowledge base; a declared source only enriches them, and every fact taken from it is labelled external and unverified. It follows *Setting up a source* in `ai-factory/docs/knowledge.md`: it offers the sources your session lists (and the one you name), asks what the source is for, writes the declaration after you confirm, asks whether to commit it, and proves it with one read-only query.

Attaching the server itself is your job, in your own tool settings; this command never writes tool configuration.

See also: [workflow.md: External knowledge](../../ai-factory/docs/workflow.md#external-knowledge-read-only).

## Examples

```
/fc:setup-knowledge
/fc:setup-knowledge example_docs
```

The optional argument is the server name as your session lists it: tools named `mcp__example_docs__search` belong to `example_docs`.

## Writes

`ai-factory/knowledge_base.md`, after you confirm: one row naming the source, its kind and its use. If you choose to keep it out of Git, it also adds that path to `ai-factory/.gitignore`. It never writes to the source.

## Refuses or asks

- Stops before reading or writing if `ai-factory/docs/knowledge.md` is missing: the layout predates knowledge-source support, and `/fc:sync-sdlc` reports it as an upstream file to take.
- Stops in a non-interactive session.
- Writes nothing if the chosen source is not listed in the session, and names the fix.
- Refuses a name already declared; asks a second time before adding to an existing declaration.
- Asks for one query to prove it; with none, reports the source as declared but unverified.
